# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed perf ports and Skia m151** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot color and text paths to allocation-free managed code. Colour conversion, premultiply math, and HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing move to managed, zero/low-allocation implementations, alongside WASM .NET 11 support and a native resource-leak fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia Chrome milestone m151** — Bundles the Skia m151 engine, plus several rounds of merged upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes and a restore of SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak fixed** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks the underlying native resource. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **WASM exception handling and .NET 11 support** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11, builds emsdk with the new exnref exception handling, and adds a WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## API Surface

- **Faster colour conversion and parsing** — SKColor <-> SKColorF conversion and premultiply math move to managed integer math, SKColor hex parsing is optimized with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, and the unnecessary unsafe modifier is removed from GRContextOptions. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removes a per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse.
